name: Youth Explore Trades Sampler (Vancouver School Board)
what_you_do: Try several skilled trades in one semester. Try carpentry, electrical work, plumbing, iron work and sheet metal. Find the one that fits you.
who_can_apply: Vancouver School Board students. Apply in grade 11 for grade 12, semester 2, at John Oliver Secondary. Grade 12 students can apply if a space is left.
deadline_text: Dates not stated on the page read. Ask your counsellor.
how_to_apply: Use the application on the page or ask your counsellor. Email careerprograms@vsb.bc.ca.
notes: Page says students should apply in grade 11, and that grade 12 students can apply if a space remains. Confirm with the school. Contact Mark Reid, Career Programs Teacher, mreid@vsb.bc.ca.
